cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the spare cupboard key till tomorrow. Don't tell your flatmate I've left it here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me what's in the cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you accept knowing what isn't? Nothing alive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you collect it before she gets home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Text me when she leaves work. Just 'key', please.
